summary: Diverge-converge: free prose brainstorm then native convergence
hypothesis: Freeing the brainstorm stage from the @Generable schema should unlock broader coverage by letting the adapter think without structural constraints, then the champion's native call can converge on those richer unknowns into the final 7 slots.
technique: Two sequential on-device FM calls on the champion adapter, both greedy: stage 1 is an unconstrained plain-prose brainstorm (no @Generable schema) surfacing decision-critical unknowns; stage 2 is the champion's normal native-format generation conditioned on that prose output.
result: Scored 0.344 on the full-30 greedy eval (1 win / 1 tie / 23 losses vs Sonnet), a real regression of −0.065 vs the champion's 0.409. Coverage stayed pinned at 3, and specificity and naturalness both dropped from 4→3; the convergence pass regressed toward generic and redundant sets, confirming the hypothesis was falsified — discarded, champion remains adapter_v2a_e1 at 0.409.

stages.text: Champion native-format call conditioned on prose
